no_adcom_quote.quote: There are no plans at this time that suggest nor stimulate a need for review of this NDA by an Advisory Committee Meeting.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for the original NEUPRO (rotigotine transdermal) NDA 021829. The Medical Review section 8.5 states there were no plans suggesting a need for an Advisory Committee, and the Administrative Correspondence cover sheet lists the AC meeting date as N/A and marks "Advisory Committee Meeting needed? NO." As a new chemical entity acting by a well-established mechanism without unique safety/efficacy issues, the application did not require AC consideration, so there are no AdComm-driven linkages to the approval.
